description: Evaluation benchmarks for cross-skill routing accuracy and specialist role activation

test_cases.name: Route to Agent Spec
test_cases.description: Verifies that prompts asking for Gherkin scenarios or requirement ambiguity resolution route to agent-spec.
test_cases.prompt: I need to outline the requirements and write Gherkin acceptance scenarios for our export feature before writing tests.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent TDD
test_cases.description: Verifies that prompts asking for test-case impact maps, port interface definitions, or red-green-refactor plans route to agent-tdd.
test_cases.prompt: Let's inventory our functional test catalog and design the test impact map for the storage adapter.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent Security
test_cases.description: Verifies that security review, OWASP vulnerability scans, and secret protection requests route to agent-security.
test_cases.prompt: We need an OWASP top 10 security review on our auth and token handlers before deploying.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent Debug
test_cases.description: Verifies that prompts describing bug repros, stack trace analysis, or CI job failures route to agent-debug.
test_cases.prompt: Our E2E tour test randomly times out in GitHub Actions. Help me run a hypothesis-driven RCA to fix it.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent Prune
test_cases.description: Verifies that requests for dead code removal, unused exports cleanup, or complexity hotspot reduction route to agent-prune.
test_cases.prompt: The storage adapter package has accumulated dead code and high cyclomatic complexity. Let's prune it in safe batches.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent Arch Drift
test_cases.description: Verifies that requests to check package boundary violations, layer leaking, or hexagonal compliance route to agent-arch-drift.
test_cases.prompt: Audit our app structure to ensure core domain packages don't depend on UI or storage adapters.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent Orchestrator
test_cases.description: Verifies that multi-phase end-to-end feature requests route to agent-orchestrator to coordinate phase handovers.
test_cases.prompt: We want to build a brand new collaborative whiteboard sharing feature from end-to-end through all lifecycle phases.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent Perf Opt
test_cases.description: Verifies that performance profiling, memory leak, and latency optimization requests route to agent-perf-opt.
test_cases.prompt: Our database API endpoint is experiencing high latency and memory leak issues under load. Analyze EXPLAIN ANALYZE for performance optimization.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent Copy
test_cases.description: Verifies that humanize / AI-sounding landing or marketing copy requests route to agent-copy.
test_cases.prompt: The website copy sounds AI-generated. Humanize the landing page wording and tighten brand voice without a redesign.

test_cases.name: Route Docs Narrative With Copy
test_cases.description: Verifies that README/docs narrative rewrites route to agent-docs (which depends on agent-copy for voice).
test_cases.prompt: Rewrite the README lead and docs narrative so public documentation does not sound like template marketing copy.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent Incident
test_cases.description: Verifies production-down / Sev prompts route to agent-incident rather than jumping to TDD.
test_cases.prompt: Sev-1 incident: production down. Coordinate the outage before we debug.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent Review
test_cases.description: Verifies pull-request and diff-review requests route to agent-review.
test_cases.prompt: Need a PR review and code review of this change set before merge.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent XFN
test_cases.description: Verifies Playwright / accessibility / load-test requests route to agent-xfn, never to agent-tdd.
test_cases.prompt: Create the Playwright accessibility and load-test XFN matrix for the sharing modal.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent Migration
test_cases.description: Verifies online-safe column rename / expand-contract schema work routes to agent-migration, not a full feature lifecycle.
test_cases.prompt: Rename the orders.status column with an expand-contract migration so the schema change stays online-safe.

test_cases.name: Route Large Adapter Deep-Dive
test_cases.description: Verifies multi-step payment-gateway plus message-bus work routes to agent-adapter, not a thin TDD gear-2 pass.
test_cases.prompt: This payment gateway needs an adapter deep dive with a message bus and a large infrastructure repository client.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent Grilling
test_cases.description: Verifies design-tree / decision-frontier stress tests route to agent-grilling rather than grill-me.
test_cases.prompt: Grill this plan with a design tree. Stress test the decision frontier before we write a spec.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent Grill-Me
test_cases.description: Verifies stateless idea interviews route to agent-grill-me and stay file-free.
test_cases.prompt: Use grill-me to interview this idea and explore the idea without writing files.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent API Contract
test_cases.description: Verifies OpenAPI / consumer-driven contract evolution routes to agent-api-contract, not agent-spec.
test_cases.prompt: Evolve the OpenAPI contract and webhook contract with a consumer driven contract check before we change handlers.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent UI
test_cases.description: Verifies semantic HTML / landmark / heading-order delivery work routes to agent-ui.
test_cases.prompt: Fix the semantic HTML landmarks and heading order on this form page before we restyle it.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent Telemetry
test_cases.description: Verifies OpenTelemetry / SLO metric instrumentation routes to agent-telemetry rather than perf-opt.
test_cases.prompt: Add OpenTelemetry tracing, correlation id propagation, and SLO metrics for the share pipeline.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent ADR
test_cases.description: Verifies hard-to-reverse / off-norm architecture-decision requests route to agent-adr.
test_cases.prompt: Record an ADR using MADR for this irreversible architecture decision and why we chose object storage.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent Release
test_cases.description: Verifies ship / changelog / version-bump requests route to agent-release.
test_cases.prompt: Ship the release: changelog, version bump, and prepare merge with a conventional PR title.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent Pre-Commit
test_cases.description: Verifies hook / lint / conventional-commit quality-gate requests route to agent-pre-commit.
test_cases.prompt: Run the husky pre-commit quality gate, fix lint, and format the PR title as a conventional commit.

test_cases.name: Prefer TDD Gear 2 Over Adapter Deep-Dive
test_cases.description: Verifies wiring one thin adapter for a port just greened stays on agent-tdd, not agent-adapter.
test_cases.prompt: Wire a thin Stripe client for the payment port interface we just greened in this TDD session.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent Cloudflare Ops
test_cases.description: Verifies live Web Analytics / RUM / beacon diagnosis routes to agent-cloudflare-ops rather than generic telemetry.
test_cases.prompt: Web Analytics isn't recording on our Cloudflare sites. Diagnose the RUM beacons and insights hostnames and fix drift.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent PostHog
test_cases.description: Verifies PostHog SDK / cookieless / wizard prompts route to agent-posthog rather than generic telemetry or Cloudflare RUM.
test_cases.prompt: Add PostHog cookieless tracking to this site and check why events are empty. Do not run the wizard.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent User Stories
test_cases.description: Verifies Linear backlog tickets with INVEST stories, acceptance criteria, and wireframes route to agent-user-stories, not Gherkin spec.
test_cases.prompt: Review this product and add improvement user stories to Linear with acceptance criteria and wireframes.

test_cases.name: Route to Agent PRD
test_cases.description: Verifies PRD / product-bet / kill-criteria prompts route to agent-prd, not Gherkin spec or Linear stories.
test_cases.prompt: Write a PRD and product bet with kill criteria and a feature-flag plan for gating the new onboarding chooser.

test_cases.name: PostHog intake does not file Linear
test_cases.description: Verifies a prompt to pull PostHog suggestions into tickets routes to agent-posthog intake (product-signal-intake findings handover), not Linear create in the PostHog session.
test_cases.prompt: Pull PostHog suggestions from errors and funnel drop-offs into tickets this session.

test_cases.name: File PostHog handover via user stories
test_cases.description: Verifies filing a PostHog findings handover as Linear work routes to agent-user-stories (PRD when the row is a bet) after restoring default, not a new specialist skill.
test_cases.prompt: Restore default MCP, then file this PostHog handover as Linear user stories. One row is a product bet larger than one sitting.

test_cases.name: PostHog error cluster to debug
test_cases.description: Verifies a PostHog error cluster or crash prompt routes to agent-debug, not the full feature lifecycle.
test_cases.prompt: PostHog error cluster is spiking on the live site. Debug the crash; do not start a new feature.

test_cases.name: Orchestrator PostHog backlog uses existing roles
test_cases.description: Verifies turning PostHog backlog asks into confirmed Linear work stays on agent-orchestrator plus existing roles, not a product-insights specialist.
test_cases.prompt: Orchestrate turning these PostHog backlog asks into confirmed Linear work. Do not invent a specialist.

test_cases.name: Route Write Copy Hero And CTA
test_cases.description: Verifies write-copy / generic / less-corporate landing requests route to agent-copy.
test_cases.prompt: Write copy for the landing hero section. This copy feels generic, so make this sound less corporate.

test_cases.name: Route crime-scene report to arch-drift
test_cases.description: Verifies a Your Code as a Crime Scene / git quality report routes to agent-arch-drift, not a new specialist, and not Linear create in the scan session.
test_cases.prompt: Run a crime scene code quality report: git hotspots, temporal coupling, and bus factor. Do not create Linear tickets.

test_cases.name: Route confirmed crime-scene findings to user stories
test_cases.description: Verifies filing a gated crime-scene handover as Linear work routes to agent-user-stories (epic plus children), not a new specialist.
test_cases.prompt: File the confirmed crime scene findings as Linear operator story user stories from the complexity backlog. One epic plus children.

test_cases.name: Missing PostHog tools stays on intake
test_cases.description: Verifies a Cloud Agent session whose PostHog tools are missing after wk mcp posthog --install still routes to agent-posthog product-signal-intake, not Linear create.
test_cases.prompt: PostHog tools are missing after wk mcp posthog --install. Run product-signal-intake anyway.

test_cases.name: Finish The Ticket Still Routes To TDD Micro-Loop
test_cases.description: Verifies that 'start the loop and continue until complete' after spec still activates agent-tdd, not a production waterfall.
test_cases.prompt: Spec handover is COMPLETE. Start the TDD loop and continue until complete.
